settings.title: System Preferences
settings.onlineArtworkDescription: When enabled, Sonante may send album and artist names to the public MusicBrainz and Cover Art Archive services.
settings.dopDesc: Requests DoP encapsulation from MPD for Direct output. Effective operation requires compatible MPD, ALSA path, and DAC.
settings.pipewireNotice: Audio is routed to your system sound server (PipeWire / PulseAudio), allowing playback alongside browsers, games, and notifications without locking the DAC.
settings.directNotice: Routes MPD to the selected ALSA hardware endpoint, normally hw:*. This alone does not confirm bit-for-bit integrity, absence of conversion, or the format received by the DAC.
settings.sharedActiveNotice: Audio will automatically play through the default output configured in your desktop system settings.
settings.dopOnlyDirect: DoP can be requested only in ALSA Direct mode and requires compatible MPD, ALSA path, and DAC.

wizard.step1Shared: Shared mode integrates audio with your system sound server (PipeWire / PulseAudio), allowing simultaneous playback with other applications.
wizard.subtitle: Initial Setup Wizard
wizard.step1Desc: Choose Shared Audio for the system default output or ALSA Direct for a selected hardware endpoint.
wizard.step1Direct: ALSA Direct points MPD to the selected hardware endpoint. Actual exclusivity, conversion, and supported formats depend on the ALSA configuration and DAC.
wizard.step2Title: Where does your music come from?
wizard.step2Desc: You can use local files only, your Plex server, or both simultaneously.
wizard.step2LocalDesc: Music stored on SSDs, internal hard drives, USB flash drives, or NFS/SMB network shares.
wizard.step2PlexDesc: Audio streaming from your Plex Media Server libraries.
wizard.step3LocalDesc: Add one or more folders for unified indexing.
wizard.step4PlexDesc: Authenticate with your official Plex account to automatically import your servers.
wizard.stepFinalDesc: Sonante will initialize the audio engine in the background and perform a differential scan of your tracks.

about.title: About Sonante
about.audioEngineDesc: MPD output through ALSA Direct or Shared Audio, with an optional DoP request for compatible Direct paths.
about.localDesc: Unified multi-folder indexing, instant folder browsing, and automatic deduplication.
about.plexDesc: Plex PIN/OAuth integration, LAN discovery, library browsing, and media-part playback through MPD.
about.devDesc: Built in Rust, Tauri, React, and MPD.
